title: Rav bar Yudah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: “Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Tefillat HaShachar” — so Seder HaDorot cites. Hyman says an erroneous Jerusalem Talmud text came his way, for in Berakhot 4:1, folio 27b, it reads רב כר׳ יהודה, meaning that Rav holds like Rabbi Yehudah, as is concluded explicitly there.

notes.text: The distinction between a patronymic and Rav agreeing with Rabbi Yehudah is Hyman’s explanation. The particular Seder HaDorot and Yerushalmi readings he describes await collation.
